bootstrap-data-flow.title: First-deployment bootstrap data flow
bootstrap-data-flow.description: Application RBAC, reference snapshots, and optional demo configuration are validated and inserted only into empty MongoDB collections.

celery-ingest-flow.title: Celery sample ingest flow
celery-ingest-flow.description: A watched or manually submitted YAML manifest is queued through Redis, validated and parsed by a Celery worker, committed in one MongoDB transaction, audited, and renamed done or failed. Required files must be readable; unavailable optional expected files are recorded. Dashed paths indicate validation or transaction failure.
